flavour: Shimmering light radiates from the Illusionist’s garb, dazzling and confounding the enemy.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, enemy units suffer a -1 modifier to any rolls To Hit made against the caster and any unit they have joined. If this spell is cast, the effects of any other Enchantment previously cast on any of the affected models immediately expire.

flavour: Torturous illusion grips the enemy. Only those with the strongest of wills can resist.
effect: The target enemy unit must immediately make a Leadership test. If this test is passed, it suffers D3 Strength 3 hits, each with an AP of -. If, however, this test is failed, it suffers D3+3 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -3.

flavour: An incorporeal Dragon materialises over the battlefield, stooping low to bear aloft a mighty champion.
effect: This spell can only target friendly characters. If the target friendly character is not fleeing and has not already moved during this Movement phase, it gains the Fly (10) special rule until the end of this turn.

flavour: The Illusionist conjures forth an illusory column of crystal. All that see it believe it to be utterly impenetrable.
effect: Remains in Play. Place a large (5”) blast template so that its central hole is within 9” of the caster. Whilst in play, the template does not move and is treated as impassable terrain over which no line of sight can be drawn.

flavour: The enemy is bombarded by wild and disorienting images and dancing lights that render them all but blind to the world around them.
effect: Remains in Play. Whilst this spell is in play, the target enemy unit becomes subject to the Stupidity special rule.

flavour: Like the surface of a mirror struck a mighty blow, the Illusionist’s image fractures, revealing myriad doppelganger likenesses.
effect: A single enemy unit the caster is engaged in combat with suffers 2D6 hits, resolved using the characteristics and special rules of the caster and of any weapon they carry.

flavour: Around the feet of the enemy, the earth itself shifts and blurs, causing warriors to trip and stumble upon halfimagined obstacles.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target enemy unit suffers a -2 modifier to its Movement characteristic (to a minimum of 1) and cannot march or charge. If this spell is cast, the effects of any other Hex previously cast on the target unit immediately expire.
